crashRecovery.limitations: Single hidden private fixture, automatic reload. Does not validate visible recovery UI, multi-view/stale callbacks, user recovery choice, host/GPU/network-process crashes, or durable product state.

method: Host-specific private Darwin coalition/unique-ID diagnostics outside app source; exact path, owner and identity checks. Active desktop; hidden AppKit windows; OS caches untouched.
security: Normal App Sandbox/network-client/user-selected-file entitlements and Hardened Runtime; no debug/media entitlements. No root or security relaxation.

tenIdleViewsMemory.limitations: RSS only, not physical footprint/compressed-memory accounting. Hidden windows and active desktop; no true cold-cache, energy or conferencing acceptance. One 10-minute run; 30 sequential samples are not 30 independent runs.
